action.description: How the intent's action is offered on a row; its description is the intent's summary.

confirm.description: The dialog that confirms the action, over the action facts; empty asks nothing.

group.description: The group the action is listed under.

note.description: What the action would do on this row, over the action facts.

primary.description: When the action is the row's primary one.

when.description: When the action is the row's primary one.

refuse.description: A case that offers the action disabled; the first that holds says why.

when.description: When the action is offered disabled.

why.description: Why the action is disabled, over the action facts.

surfaces.description: Where the action is offered: row, detail, tui, cli and explore when absent.

warning.description: Shown under the action, over the action facts; empty shows nothing.

when.description: When the action is offered on a row.

define.description: The template define that renders it.

dims.description: Dimensions it pins, such as { stage = "first" }.

prefix.description: What its sources are listed under; "<profile> guide: " when absent.

when.description: When the turn reads the other judgment.

answerable.description: The turn may stop on a question.

brief.description: How the turn reads the unit's brief.

need.description: The brief intent's extra fields the turn needs.

wait.description: The turn waits for the brief.

dims.description: The dimensions valid under its profile.

drafts.description: The drafts its turns' agents propose.

allowed_effects.description: The effects its agents may declare on their drafts.

approval.description: The approval of its drafts; wait when absent.

mode.description: The approval when no rule holds.

rule.description: A rule; the first whose when holds gives the mode.

when.description: When the approval rule applies to a draft.

window.description: With mode delay only: how long a person has to stop the draft.
With mode delay only: how long a person has to stop the draft.

attach_posts.description: On a turn whose unit is a task, the unit of each post its agent makes, sent at once or once approved, is attached to the task; reactions and edits are not posts.

gates.description: The gates its runs and drafts open.

mode.description: The mode when no rule holds.

rule.description: A rule; the first whose when holds gives the mode.

when.description: When the rule applies to a gate.

window.description: With mode delay only: how long a person has to stop the gate's consequence.
With mode delay only: how long a person has to stop the gate's consequence.

guidance.description: The guidance a person gives the turn.

max.description: The guidance's length cap in runes; 0 for none.

headline.description: The line that opens the turn's prompt.

new.description: A headline case; the last has no when.

line.description: The headline, over the turn's facts.

resumed.description: What a resumed turn continues, over the turn's facts.

docs.description: A page path of the documentation site.

examples.description: Command lines without the command's name.

group.description: The title of the main help's group that lists the command, free text; action.group is the action's.

summary.description: The main help's line; the intent's summary when absent.

target.description: Free text saying what the command's argument names, such as a pull request URL.

before.description: What runs before the turn when it is set.

by_hand_only.description: An automated turn never sets it.

flag.description: The CLI flag that sets it; required from the user.

help.description: What it does; required from the user.

max.description: A text input's length cap in runes; 0 for none.

persist.description: Stored with the turn, restored on resume.

surfaces.description: Where it is offered; cli and instructions when absent.

join.description: When a request joins an open turn.

differs_on.description: Persisted inputs whose change starts a new turn.

owner_only.description: The unit must be yours or taken over.

profile.description: The intent whose judgment blocks the turn reads, or none; the configuration's profile is the profile directory.

prompt.description: A builder's prompt file, through the profile layers.

provider.description: The units its turns serve: a provider id, a list of them, or any; defaults.toml provider when absent.

artifacts.description: The artifacts a record may carry.

attach_url.description: On a turn whose unit is a task, a done record's outcome url, when it names a unit such as a pull request, attaches that unit to the task; needs url in record.outcome.

history_artifact.description: The artifact the unit's history shows.

missing.description: The gate, of gates.toml, a run that ends without the record requires names opens. Required with requires.

outcome.description: The outcome fields a record may carry.

outcome_doc.description: What the outcome holds, for the instructions.

require.description: What a record in a state must carry; record.requires is the record kind a run owes.

fields.description: The outcome fields it must carry.

requires.description: The record kind, of records.toml, a run of the intent owes; a run that ends without it opens the gate missing names. Left out, a run owes no record. Not record.require, what a record in a state carries.

states.description: The states a record may take. Required when the table sets when, artifacts, outcome, require or attach_url; a table that only sets requires and missing needs none.

when.description: When the turn records its outcome.

refuse.description: A refusal of turn.start; the first whose when holds refuses with its why.

when.description: When it refuses, over the unit's workflow facts.

why.description: What the refusal says, over the unit's workflow facts.

changed.description: The text when the unit changed since the question.

role.description: What binds it to a plugin's mechanism. One intent per role and provider.

runners.description: How its turns may run; ["session"] when absent.

schema.description: A builder's extra fields' schema file, beside the manifest.

session.description: The agent session its turns run in.

close_when_done.description: The session closes when its turn is done.

name.description: What the workspace manager and the agent show the session as, over the name facts; defaults.toml session_name when absent, else the title. A name that session.title leads and the start time ends, as dd/mm hh:mm, lets the loop recognize its session when it lost track of it.

strategy.description: Whether a turn reuses the unit's live session or starts a new one.

title.description: The session's title: 1 to 12 lowercase letters.

shortcut.description: One uppercase letter for its action, not a built-in action's.

skill.description: Install writes it a turn skill; needs help.target.

summary.description: One line on what it does: its action's tooltip, its help line, its profile listing. Required.

target.description: What a run with no unit does.

missing.description: capture: a run with no unit captures its guidance as a new task, the turn's unit; refused when absent.

title.description: The captured task's title, over .guidance, with firstLine.

user_facing.description: Offered as a command, a skill and an action.

why.description: Why the turn is due, over the unit's workflow facts.

workspace.description: Where its turn runs, and the board it moves: a workspace builtin, or a table naming the repository.

name.description: The name of the worktree created for the turn's unit, over the name facts, with slug; the loop's own when absent.

repo.description: The repository the turn runs in, owner/name.

repo_input.description: The input that holds the repository the turn runs in.

repo_optional.description: With repo_input: a turn whose input names no repository runs in the neutral repository, with no checkout.
